payload.title: NVFP4/MXFP4 Numeric System: PTX, CUTLASS, Triton, and Quantization
payload.summary: Comprehensive analysis of the NVFP4 and MXFP4 numeric systems — covering the mathematical foundations, PTX instruction paths, CUTLASS/Triton operator implementations, and quantization recipes for inference and training.

sections.heading: 1. Background: Why Microscaling FP4 Exists
sections.gist: INT8 quantization is mature, but pushing to 4-bit presents two paths: INT4 or FP4.

sections.heading: 2. Numeric Fundamentals: Structure and Error Intuition
sections.gist: Both formats use FP4 E2M1: 1-bit sign + 2-bit exponent + 1-bit mantissa.

sections.heading: 3. PTX Instruction Layer: MXFP4/NVFP4 on Blackwell
6. Summary
sections.gist: MXFP4 and NVFP4 mark a turning point: FP4 enters the era of complete ecosystems with formats, instructions, and recipes.
